heading: Oregon
lead: Oregon constitutes one judicial district. Court shall be held at Coquille, Eugene or Springfield, Klamath Falls, Medford, Pendleton, and Portland.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 183 (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 102, 36 Stat. 1122; Nov. 6, 1945, ch. 447, 59 Stat. 555). Provisions relating to appointment and residence of deputies by the clerk and marshal, and maintenance of offices by said officers, were omitted as covered by sections 541 [see 561], 542 [see 561], and 751 of this title. Changes in arrangement and phraseology were made.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2000—Pub. L. 106–518 substituted “Eugene or Springfield” for “Eugene”. 1970—Pub. L. 91–272 provided for holding court at Coquille. 1950—Act Aug. 3, 1950, provided for holding court at Eugene.
